title: Final Approval
description: Written by the orchestrator after ratifying peer consensus. This is the last file written in the workspace. Once it exists, all workers are set to APPROVED and may exit. Domain-agnostic.

checkpointRef.description: Path to the orchestrator checkpoint that ratified consensus.

consensusRound.description: Which consensus round achieved peer agreement.

workersApproved.description: Worker IDs whose ralph-loop status will be set to APPROVED.
